title: CLCON/632/2018 of KISHAN LAL Vs ALOK MISHRA

paras.text:
CLCON No. 632 of 2018
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, Advocate for the
applicants.
Mr. Rakesh Thapliyal, Assistant Solicitor
General for Union of India/respondent.
The present Contempt Petition was
preferred by the petitioner alleging non-compliance of the judgment dated 07.04.2017
and 03.07.2017 passed by the learned Single
Judge in Writ Petition (S/S) No. 2024/2016
'Kishan Lal and another vs. Union of India and
others', wherein, a direction was issued to the
Board of Governors of IIT, Roorkee, to take
final decision for the payment of scale of Rs.
3200 to 4900 w.e.f. 2001, in place of Rs. 3050-
4590, which already stood recommended by
respondent no. 3 in favour of the petitioner,
within eight weeks, seeking compliance of the
judgment dated 07.04.2017 and 03.07.2017,
whereby, the respondent no. 2 was directed to
take a final decision on the recommendation
dated 27.01.2016 within a period of eight
weeks from the date of the order.
The said order later on was served on the
Director, IIT, Government of India, vide letter
dated 29.04.2017. When the order was not
complied with, the petitioner has filed the
present Contempt Petition on which this Court
on 20.09.2018, the notice was issued to the
respondent. When no response was given and
neither the respondent appeared in person on
the said date, the Court was constraint to pass
an order of issuance of bailable warrant of
`5,000/-, which was issued against the
respondent to secure his presence.
In compliance thereto, an affidavit by
way of Civil Miscellaneous Application No.
11920/2018 had been filed before this Court. In

the compliance application as filed by the
respondent on 18.12.2018 he had submitted that
the orders now stands complied with, in view of
the order passed on 27.10.2018.
Consequently, this contempt proceeding
is closed. Notice issued against the respondents
is discharged. The order dated 27.10.2018
issuing bailable warrants is hereby recalled.
Contempt Petition is, accordingly,
closed. Notices are discharged.
